From 80fa40acaa1dad5a0a9c15ed2e5d2e72461843f5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Florian Fainelli <f.fainelli@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Apr 2016 15:35:39 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] MIPS: BMIPS: Adjust mips-hpt-frequency for BCM7435

The CPU actually runs at 1405Mhz which gives us a 175625000 Hz MIPS timer
frequency (CPU frequency / 8).

Fixes: e4c7d009654a ("MIPS: BMIPS: Add BCM7435 dtsi")
Signed-off-by: Florian Fainelli <f.fainelli@gmail.com>
Cc: linux-mips@linux-mips.org
Cc: john@phrozen.org
Cc: cernekee@gmail.com
Cc: jaedon.shin@gmail.com
Patchwork: https://patchwork.linux-mips.org/patch/13132/
Signed-off-by: Ralf Baechle <ralf@linux-mips.org>

diff --git a/arch/mips/boot/dts/brcm/bcm7435.dtsi b/arch/mips/boot/dts/brcm/bcm7435.dtsi
index cce752b27055..a874d3a0e2ee 100644
--- a/arch/mips/boot/dts/brcm/bcm7435.dtsi
+++ b/arch/mips/boot/dts/brcm/bcm7435.dtsi
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@ cpus {
 		#address-cells = <1>;
 		#size-cells = <0>;
 
-		mips-hpt-frequency = <163125000>;
+		mips-hpt-frequency = <175625000>;
 
 		cpu@0 {
 			compatible = "brcm,bmips5200";
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/mips/boot/dts/brcm/bcm7435.dtsi`**
   - The value of the property `mips-hpt-frequency` was changed from `<163125000>` to `<175625000>`. This adjustment reflects the correct MIPS timer frequency based on the actual CPU frequency of 1405 MHz.

### Relationships

- The modification in the `bcm7435.dtsi` file is a bug fix that corrects the MIPS timer frequency for the BCM7435 CPU. This change is directly related to the previous commit identified by the hash `e4c7d009654a`, which added support for the BCM7435 device tree. The fix ensures that the timer frequency is accurately represented, which is crucial for the proper functioning of the system.

The bug was caused by an incorrect value for the `mips-hpt-frequency` property in the device tree source file, which did not reflect the actual CPU frequency of the BCM7435. The original value of `<163125000>` was inaccurate, leading to potential timing issues in the system's operation.
